listing.name: Persona 3 FES — p3fes-recompiled (poopoocacacacaca)
listing.summary: Boot, menus and New Game are reported to work. Further gameplay is not established by this status. This implementation remains separate from the VirtualAK runtime. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U SLUS21621 disc data, including its CVM and IRX files. The ELF must have SHA1 7ca061aac239e53e86bcd4c0ce8e19e987d8a75f.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate code and build locally using the project’s instructions. Keep your own CVM and ELF files beside the runtime.

warnings: Boot, menus and New Game are reported to work. Further gameplay is not established by this status. This implementation remains separate from the VirtualAK runtime.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
